content.text:
I've submitted index 8 (Cu 0.58 / Sb 0.42) as the best composition, and the episode is finished. Its measured EQE was about 0.0010%, and whether that is near the library's best is unknown.

The merit budget allowed only three measurements:

| Index | Cu : Sb | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 16 | 0.32 : 0.68 (close to the CuSb₂O₆ ratio) | −0.00009 |
| 8 | 0.58 : 0.42 | **0.0010** |
| 3 | 0.73 : 0.27 | 0.00006 |

All three values are very small. The best composition probably lies somewhere between Cu 0.4 and 0.7, but three points can't pin down the peak. The best untested spots are probably near indices 6–7 (close to the Cu₂SbO₅ ratio) or 9–11.

I didn't use any of the five XRD measurements, so I have no phase identification to back up the result. I also didn't ask the Gaussian-process tool for suggestions before choosing where to measure.
